786:/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
787: * Function:        H5G_traverse
788: *
789: * Purpose: Traverse a path from a location & perform an operation when
790: *              the last component of the name is reached.
791: *
792: * Return:  Success:        Non-negative if path can be fully traversed.
793: *          Failure:        Negative if the path could not be fully
794: *                          traversed.
795: *
796: * Programmer:      Quincey Koziol
797: *          Sep 13 2005
798: *
799: *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
800: */
801:herr_t
802:H5G_traverse(const H5G_loc_t *loc, const char *name, unsigned target, H5G_traverse_t op, void *op_data)
803:{
804:    size_t orig_nlinks;         /* Original value for # of soft / UD links able to traverse */
805:    herr_t ret_value = SUCCEED; /* Return value */
806:
807:    FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI(FAIL)
808:
809:    /* Check args */
810:    if (!name || !*name)
811:        HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_NOTFOUND, FAIL, "no name given")
812:    if (!loc)
813:        HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_NOTFOUND, FAIL, "no starting location")
814:    if (!op)
815:        HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_NOTFOUND, FAIL, "no operation provided")
816:
817:    /* Retrieve the original # of soft / UD links that are able to be traversed
818:     * (So that multiple calls to H5G_traverse don't incorrectly look
819:     *  like they've traversed too many.  Nested calls, like in H5L__move(),
820:     *  may need their own mechanism to set & reset the # of links to traverse)
821:     */
822:    if (H5CX_get_nlinks(&orig_nlinks) < 0)
823:        HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTGET, FAIL, "unable to retrieve # of soft / UD links to traverse")
824:
825:    /* Set up invalid tag. This is a precautionary step only. Setting an invalid
826:     * tag here will ensure that no metadata accessed while doing the traversal
827:     * is given an improper tag, unless another one is specifically set up
828:     * first. This will ensure we're not accidentally tagging something we
829:     * shouldn't be during the traversal. Note that for best tagging assertion
830:     * coverage, setting H5C_DO_TAGGING_SANITY_CHECKS is advised.
831:     */
832:    H5_BEGIN_TAG(H5AC__INVALID_TAG);
833:
834:    /* Go perform "real" traversal */
835:    if (H5G__traverse_real(loc, name, target, op, op_data) < 0)
836:        HGOTO_ERROR_TAG(H5E_SYM, H5E_NOTFOUND, FAIL, "internal path traversal failed")
837:
838:    /* Reset tag after traversal */
839:    H5_END_TAG
840:
841:    /* Reset the # of soft / UD links that can be traversed */
842:    if (H5CX_set_nlinks(orig_nlinks) < 0)
843:        HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_SYM, H5E_CANTSET, FAIL, "can't reset # of soft / UD links to traverse")
844:
845:done:
846:    FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
847:} /* end H5G_traverse() */
